review.assessment: The change introduces solution.mjs as a new file containing a minimal deepEqual implementation that delegates entirely to JSON.stringify. While this passes the already-recorded acceptance checks, it structurally cannot satisfy the stated requirements because JSON serialization inherently drops undefined values and converts NaN to null. The implementation leaves multiple specified edge cases incorrectly returning true due to loss of type and structure information.

findings.defect: Incorrectly equates NaN and null due to serialization loss
Treats explicit undefined properties as missing keys because JSON.stringify drops them
